mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'list' pages through DGCP's public tender feed and returns tender records. 'detail' fetches one specific tender by its OCDS 'ocid' (e.g. from a previous 'list' run).

maxResults.title: Max results (list mode)
maxResults.description: Maximum number of tenders to return for a 'list' run. The feed returns 10 records per page and has no server-side filtering (see README) -- this actor pages forward until it reaches this many results.

startCursor.title: Resume from cursor (list mode, advanced)
startCursor.description: Optional. The feed has no date/keyword filter, so to see more of it (rather than the same first page every run) pass the '_nextCursor' value from the last record of a previous 'list' run here to continue exactly where it left off. Leave empty to start from the beginning of the feed.

ocid.title: Tender OCID (detail mode)
ocid.description: A single OCDS 'ocid' to fetch (e.g. the 'ocid' field from a 'list' mode run).

ocids.title: Tender OCIDs (detail mode)
ocids.description: Multiple OCDS 'ocid's to fetch in one run. Combined with 'ocid' if both are set.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (detail mode)
maxConcurrency.description: How many tender OCIDs to fetch in parallel in 'detail' mode.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
